name: The Space Between Us
source:
The new year has only just begun, and you're already sick in bed.

But don’t worry – your colleague has taken it upon himself to look after you. You didn’t even have to ask.

How considerate of him, right?

[From [url=https://maplegame31.itch.io/the-space-between-us]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
新的一年才刚刚开始，你就已经卧病在床了。

但别担心——你的同事已经承担起照顾你的责任。你甚至不必问。

多体贴他吧？

[来自[url=https://maplegame31.itch.io/the-space-between-us]Itch.io[/url]]
